messages:
Ella (solutions): Quick: NovaRetail POC tomorrow. Theyre seeing intermittent 429s on streaming handshakes and occasionally malformed tool outputs. Need a short troubleshooting checklist for their infra team.
Samir (eng): Is the 429 on POST /v1/stream/handshake or websocket open?
Ella (solutions): POST /v1/stream/handshake. Happens under load when they spin up 12 connectors.
Priya (runtime): Likely token reuse + burst hitting per-client rate limiter. If they share one ephemeral token across many connectors you get a thundering herd.
Noah (presales): Billing question: will failed handshakes be billed? Customer wants cost estimate for worst-case reconnects.
Priya (runtime): Failed handshakes are not billed. Successful stream sessions and tokens minted are billable; partial model outputs that were produced server-side will count. Recommend idempotent checkpoints to reduce cost.
Samir (eng): For malformed tool outputs: usually client-side assembly issue. In streaming we send JSON fragments; if client closes early you get invalid JSON.
Ella (solutions): Can you share corpus-safe snippets we can hand to their devs?
Samir (eng): Short snippets: 1) retry/backoff pseudocode with jitter, 2) streaming assembly loop that waits for final marker before JSON parse, 3) advice to increase socket keepalive.
Priya (runtime): Runtime tips: stagger token TTLs per connector, set token TTL ~45s, add exponential backoff with jitter, enable per-connector circuit breaker (50% errors -> pause), and export metrics: handshake_attempts, handshake_429, token_renewals.
Noah (presales): Security FAQ: can tokens be rotated centrally and audited?
Priya (runtime): Yes. For Private/Dedicated customers we recommend KMS-backed signing and audit logs. Hosted can use our token broker with audit export on request.
deploy-bot: deploy requested by @Ella (solutions): poc-token-rotation-snippets -> cluster/beta (status: queued)
Ella (solutions): Action items: Samir  produce snippets + runbook by EOD; Priya  short runtime checklist; Noah  update SOW blurb on billing + compliance. I'll follow up with NovaRetail.
Samir (eng): On it.
Priya (runtime): Will add a small k8s sidecar example for token minting with leader lock.
